interface.name: cc-libs
interface.summary: C/C++ compiler runtime libraries for MinGW-w64
interface.description: Runtime libraries required by C++ programs built with the MinGW-w64 toolchains that MSYS2 uses: GCC's libgcc and libstdc++ on x86-64 and LLVM's libc++ and libunwind on ARM64. Feeds for MSYS2-based packages depend on this instead of on a specific toolchain's libraries.
